motion.geometryPolicy: Original connected CAD meshes and material slots; object matrices only. No hidden moving components or altered guide bores.
motion.seekPolicy: Absolute matrices from the source assembly; exact source matrices at both endpoints.
motion.motion: Both orange wheels and their metal hubs roll about their actual common X axle while the entire assembled chassis sways left and right about its axle midpoint.
motion.source: tools/editorial-render/sources/lineFollower.glb; original included CAD parts with separately shaded finish surfaces.
motion.limitations: An anchored operating illustration: common forward wheel rotation represents travel while the display suppresses chassis translation. The differential contribution matches the signed wheel-center motion induced by the left/right yaw. No measured line trajectory, controller response, tire slip or vehicle speed is claimed.

cameraTracking: Original source camera position and direction
